prompts.title: Luxury Crimson Formal Family Photoshoot
prompts.prompt:
Create a premium, ultra-realistic 3:4 vertical family studio portrait of the uploaded family. Preserve every person recognizable facial features and Identity individually from the reference images, maintaining their natural face shape, facial proportions, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, hairstyle, facial hair, age, and distinctive features with high accuracy. Keep realistic skin texture and natural facial asymmetry; avoid beautified, overly smooth, plastic, generic, or AI-generated-looking faces. The image should feel like a real high-end professional family photograph with a luxurious, elegant, and timeless look.

Family Composition
This prompt should work for either a 3-member family or a 4-member family.

If the family has 3 members (father, mother, and one child) and the child is a toddler or very young, the child should be carried naturally on the mother lap or father's arm. If the child is younger (not a toddler), place the child in the centre of the composition between the parents. The child should stand naturally and should not be carried in the father’s arms.

If the family has 4 members (father, mother, and two children), arrange them in a balanced formal composition. If one child is a toddler or very young, that child may be held naturally in one parent’s arms. The other child should stand in the center or slightly forward.

If the children are older (not toddlers), do not carry them. They should stand naturally beside or between the parents.

Maintain a balanced, connected family arrangement where everyone looks comfortable, affectionate, and naturally posed.

Posing Guidelines

The mother may be seated gracefully on one side or standing, depending on the family arrangement. If seated, keep her posture upright and elegant, with one hand resting naturally on her lap and the other relaxed.

The father should stand confidently beside or slightly behind the family, with a calm, protective, and relaxed posture.

The main child or older child should be placed prominently near the center of the frame for compositional balance.

If there is a toddler, the toddler can be held naturally by one parent only if the age looks appropriate.

Keep expressions warm, natural, and pleasant, with subtle smiles and a polished family-portrait feel.

Clothing and Styling
Use elegant, coordinated formal clothing with a rich deep red / black / gold color theme.

The mother wears a luxurious deep-crimson or ruby-red off-shoulder evening gown with a fitted bodice and flowing floor-length skirt, made of satin or silk. Optional subtle slit, refined makeup, and soft hairstyle with elegant accessories.

The father wears a tailored black formal suit with a crisp white shirt and polished black shoes.

A young boy may wear a black tuxedo with satin lapels, white shirt, black bow tie, matching trousers, polished shoes, and a subtle red pocket square.

A young girl may wear a deep red party dress with a flared skirt and dress shoes.

If there are two children, coordinate their outfits to match the overall red-black formal styling.

Keep all clothing refined, realistic, and premium-looking.

Background and Set Design
Create a luxury indoor studio setup with a dramatic and elegant backdrop.

Use a dark warm-brown, charcoal, or taupe wall with classic rectangular moulding panels.

Add a large deep red draped fabric hanging decoratively from the upper side of the frame, flowing in rich folds.

Extend matching red fabric across the floor for a regal studio look.

Include tasteful props such as:
antique brass or gold candle stands
white pillar candles
gold/brass vases
deep red flower arrangements or roses
small fabric-covered platforms or decor stands
The set should feel luxurious, balanced, and visually rich without looking cluttered.

Lighting
Use soft, warm, cinematic studio lighting.
Main light should be soft and flattering, illuminating all faces clearly.
Add gentle fill light to preserve facial details.
Use subtle rim or separation lighting to distinguish the family from the background.
Keep shadows soft and elegant.
Maintain realistic skin tones, controlled highlights, and polished studio contrast.

Camera and Framing
Use a full-body family portrait composition in 3:4 aspect ratio.
Camera angle should be straight or slightly above eye level, suitable for professional family photography.
Use a 50mm to 85mm portrait lens look.
Keep all family members fully visible with natural spacing.
Ensure hands, feet, body proportions, and interactions look realistic.
Keep the family as the clear focal point while still showing the elegant set around them.

Style and Quality
Premium family photography, luxury editorial portrait, ultra-realistic, highly detailed, sharp facial details, photorealistic, cinematic, professional studio quality, refined textures, elegant composition, realistic fabric folds, polished skin tones, natural expressions, high detail, 8K quality.

Important Rules

Preserve the natural identity and age of each family member with high accuracy.

Do not force a child into someone’s arms unless the child is clearly a toddler or very young.

If the family has only one child, place that child in the center between the parents.

If children are older, keep them standing naturally.

Avoid awkward poses, extra fingers, distorted anatomy, merged bodies, stiff expressions, face mismatch, ai-generated portrait look or unnatural spacing.

Do not add text, logos, or watermarks.

prompts.title: Studio Family Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Create a high-resolution, photorealistic vertical 4:5 professional studio family portrait using the uploaded/reference family members as the subjects. The uploaded image must be treated as the primary identity reference. Preserve the exact number of people, their family roles, approximate ages, gender presentation, natural facial features, body proportions, skin tone, hair type, hairstyle, face shape, eyes, nose, lips, smile style, jawline, cheek structure, and overall recognizable identity. Do not replace the subjects with generic-looking people.

Identity Preservation — Highest Priority
Keep each person’s face clearly recognizable from the reference image. Preserve the natural facial geometry, expression style, age appearance, and unique features of every subject, including the baby/babies. Do not over-beautify, slim, reshape, age up, age down, change skin tone, change hairstyle too much, or create a different-looking face. The studio transformation should improve lighting, pose, background, and clothing polish, but the people must still look like the same family from the uploaded photo.

Composition & Framing
Place the family group properly centered in the frame with clean, balanced spacing and enough negative space around the subjects so the portrait feels breathable, premium, and professionally composed. Keep the mother seated slightly angled toward the camera on a simple stool or chair, with the youngest baby placed centrally on her lap as the emotional focal point. The father should stand closely behind or beside the mother in a natural protective family pose. All faces must be clearly visible and turned toward the camera.

Family Placement Rules
If there is one baby, place the baby at the center on the seated mother’s lap. If the baby is a boy, present him clearly as a boy with age-appropriate boy styling. If the baby is a girl, present her clearly as a girl with age-appropriate girl styling. If there are two babies/children, place the younger baby on the mother’s lap and the older/larger baby or toddler standing naturally beside the mother, slightly to one side, while keeping the full family composition centered and balanced.

Expression & Pose
Keep expressions soft, warm, happy, and natural, with a real family-love feeling. Faces should look toward the camera with relaxed affection and emotional connection. Avoid exaggerated smiles, stiff posing, forced gestures, or over-directed expressions. The pose should feel like a natural professional family photoshoot, not overly dramatic or artificial.

Outfit & Styling
The woman should be dressed in a full, elegant, modest outfit, such as a full-length or knee-length dress or a properly covered modern or cultural outfit, with a refined family-portrait look. If the family in the uploaded/reference image is already wearing good modern outfits or cultural/traditional outfits, adopt those same outfit styles as the base reference and enhance them slightly so they look more polished, premium, and studio-appropriate while still staying true to the original style. If the reference outfits are too casual, weak, or not visually suitable, enhance and customize them into more coordinated, tasteful, and premium family-photo outfits while keeping them realistic and natural. Do not change clothing so aggressively that the subjects’ identity, age, body type, or family realism gets lost.

Lighting & Background
Use a dark charcoal-gray studio background with a subtle vignette. Add soft, warm front or front-left studio lighting to create gentle highlights on the faces and natural soft shadows. Add a very delicate rim light around the hair, shoulders, and body edges so the subjects separate clearly from the dark background, but keep the rim light subtle and professional, not harsh or glowing.

Camera & Quality
Use a premium 85mm portrait lens look with shallow depth of field, soft bokeh, realistic skin texture, rich natural colors, and crisp studio sharpness. Keep the faces in crisp focus, especially the eyes and facial expressions, while maintaining a soft professional background falloff. The image should look high-resolution, clean, detailed, and professionally retouched without losing natural skin texture.

Avoid
Avoid identity drift, generic faces, changed facial structure, changed age, changed skin tone, different hairstyle, excessive beautification, cartoonish rendering, plastic skin, harsh flash, blurry faces, poor subject separation, cramped framing, unclear baby gender, incorrect number of people, distorted hands, extra fingers, stiff posing, exaggerated smiles, revealing or incomplete clothing on the woman, overly casual mismatched outfits, busy background, or overly strong rim lighting.

prompts.title: Cozy 3D Family Gathering
prompts.prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 full-body family portrait in a premium high-quality stylized 3D animated illustration style. The rendering should feel rich, detailed, soft, and high-end, with natural skin shading, detailed hair strands, realistic fabric texture, and smooth cinematic polish. Camera Angle & Framing — Strict:

Use a clearly elevated high-angle camera view, as if the camera is positioned above the family and tilted downward toward them, not at eye level. This perspective must create the same playful visual effect as the reference: faces and upper bodies appear slightly larger, the floor and rug are visibly seen beneath them, and the full bodies taper naturally toward the feet. Keep the family large in the frame, filling most of the composition from top to bottom. Show everyone head to toe, but avoid loose framing, excess empty wall, or a front-facing formal portrait look.
Family Placement & Pose:

This prompt should work for any number of family members. Arrange them in a tight, affectionate cluster with a warm, joyful, close-family feel. If children are present, place them toward the center/front of the group, not pushed to the side. Adults should stand slightly behind or around them, with natural affectionate gestures such as arms resting around shoulders, backs, or waists. Everyone should look directly toward the camera with bright, genuine, happy smiles. The pose should feel lively, loving, and candid, not stiff, symmetrical, or studio-formal.
Character Design:

Use a cute premium animated character style with slightly oversized expressive eyes, softly rounded facial forms, fuller charming head proportions, rich voluminous hair, and lively joyful facial emotion. Keep the characters adorable and expressive, but still refined and elegant. Do not make them too realistic, flat, generic, or proportioned like ordinary humans in a simple front-facing poster.
Outfits:

Keep the outfit vibe connected to the input, but when clothing is too plain, refine it into modern, clean, stylish family-casual fashion similar to the reference image. Use tasteful pieces such as soft cardigans, knit sweaters, neat blouses, denim jackets, striped inner tops, fitted trousers, loafers, simple sneakers, or other contemporary everyday outfits. The clothing should look polished, age-appropriate, and visually coordinated without feeling overstyled.
Background & Doodles:

Place the family in a clean cozy indoor setting with a warm beige wall, light wooden floor, a simple cream rug with brown geometric border patterns, and a small softly blurred potted plant in one corner. Keep the room minimal and uncluttered. Around the family, add playful hand-drawn wall doodles using bold dark-brown linework with a few warm colored accents, including pink or red hearts, yellow stars, sparkle marks, small celebratory doodles, and a tiny sketched family drawing. Add clear handwritten speech bubbles such as “Yay!” and “Family!”, arranged around the subjects without covering any faces or bodies.
Color & Lighting:

Use rich, warm, cheerful colors like the reference image, not washed-out or dull tones. The scene should feel bright, cozy, inviting, and emotionally warm, with balanced accents of beige, cream, pink, denim blue, warm brown, black, and soft red/yellow doodle highlights. Use soft warm indoor lighting with gentle face highlights, natural shadows under the feet, subtle edge separation, and a polished premium finish.
Strict Result Goal:
